scope: User-requested source-backed horizontal Kumo subspace ensemble over all audited existing features and actuarial extensions.

confirmation.selection: Original inner correction data only; do not choose shortlist using outer KS.

ensemble_rule.inner_roles: Stratified half of the 6k ranks subspaces; other half selects count and blend weight, seed261026.
ensemble_rule.baseline: Original Kumo90 raw predictions; mature correction18 plus spline77 is downstream comparator.
ensemble_rule.ties: Smaller blend weight, then fewer members.
ensemble_rule.final_head: Fit fixed .003/.5 head on original 6k using selected raw mixture; .75 corrected + .25 unchanged mature spline.

retention: Recipes, sources, hashes, seeds, prediction arrays and metrics only. Shared original pretrained checkpoint cache; no fitted weights or KV caches. Features generated lazily.
timing_policy: Check raw timestamps and DPD <= elapsed due-date age; inherited snapshot collection semantics remain an assumption and are recorded. All new transforms use only predecision input values.
boundary_policy: Context-only preprocessing, posterior priors, vocabulary and duplicate/constant detection; no outer-label fitting, no target columns as features.
uncertainty: Paired row-stratified bootstrap2000 for final pooled difference, fold deltas and seed sensitivity. Development evidence only; old outer labels previously exposed.
success_rule: Development KS >= .54 reported separately from generalization; promote only with positive paired gain and stability, then evaluate possible submission.
restart_policy: Resume same frozen deadline; incomplete models remain incomplete.
